name: iinsha-engineering-ops
description: Project-aware engineering orchestration for IINSHA: safe GitHub release audits, Supabase and Cloudflare diagnostics, security reviews, and browser QA.
suggestedPrompts: Run an evidence-based IINSHA release readiness audit without changing production.
Reconcile the local V7 candidate with GitHub master, PR #67, PR #71, and the latest exact-SHA CI runs.
Audit Supabase project identity, migration history, RLS, and tenant isolation using read-only access first.
Run a full Playwright regression audit of IINSHA public routes, service search, forms, checkout validation, and six responsive viewports.
Prepare a safe Cloudflare Pages and Durable Objects deployment plan with explicit owner approval gates.
